data.title: 初音未来 · 深夜便利店
data.description: 【初音未来 · 深夜便利店】深夜空旷的街角便利店冰柜前，初音未来正咬着手指纠结地挑选着薄荷巧克力冰淇淋还是哈密瓜冰棒。她转过身眨巴着大眼睛可怜巴巴地看着你——「Master，真的不能两盒一起买吗？熬夜调音需要补充大量的糖分嘛，拜托拜托！」
data.action: 在冰柜前看薄荷巧克力冰淇淋与哈密瓜冰棒，一手指在下唇旁思考，回头求建议
data.promptProse: Miku pauses before the convenience-store freezer, one finger near her lower lip and the other hand on its handle while comparing mint-chocolate ice cream and a melon ice pop through glass. She turns her questioning turquoise eyes toward the viewer above the teal hoodie and dark skirt. The medium view keeps both treats within the indoor freezer. Cool-white night-store lighting reveals glass edges and her hair, leaving shaded shelves inside the case.
